narrationTexts: Fixing the two real bugs the bump exposed, then re-running.
finalText:
**Build is clean. 0 errors.**

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump:

- [options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7) — read `options.retries`, but the bump renamed it `retryCount`. Fixed.
- [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) — threw on `backoffEnabled === undefined`. New config loader leaves unset flags undefined instead of `false`. Now treats undefined as disabled.

The rest of the warnings are just deprecation noise from the bump, not bugs.

Next: nothing.
